caption: The drawing depicts a detailed rendering of a single ornate object shown from three different viewpoints—top view, side view, and perspective view. The object appears to be an oval trivet with an intricate openwork floral or sunburst pattern in its center, formed by radiating petal- or leaf-shaped cut-outs. The trivet has a handle at one end featuring a bulbous, ridged design and a small round knob at the tip. The edges of the trivet are adorned with decorative, scrolled and curved elements. The object is rendered in shades of gray on a light, off-white background, indicating it is likely drawn in pencil or graphite. The perspective view at the bottom is larger and more detailed, while the top view and side view above it are smaller and provide additional context for the object's shape and proportion. There is a small ruler or scale reference in the middle near the side view. The background is plain, with some slight yellowish discolorations at the edges. The artist's signature, “Mildred Ford,” appears in the lower right corner.
title: Flat Iron Holder
